Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes — we handle a damaged/defective/incorrect item differently than a normal return.
For a normal return: returns are accepted for 30 days from the delivery date, you need an RMA before shipping anything back, items must be uninstalled/unused and in the original packaging, and authorized returns are typically subject to a 20% restocking fee (plus return shipping).
For a damaged item: please contact us within 5 business days of delivery with your order number and photos of the item and packaging. We’ll make it right at no cost to you — no restocking fee, no processing fee, and we cover return shipping.
